When I posted a message appealing for unity & peace in today's protest I had never imagined that the biggest democracy in the world would be under an undeclared EMERGENCY.
I was happy there were so many leaders to lead the movement. I hope those arrested will be released soon. I will be compelled to consider Anshan Fast or Padyatra March if they are not released by tomorrow.
#JantarMantar #protest #CJP #CEC #sonamwangchuk".

573K likes, 5,642 comments - wangchuksworld on October 9, 2026: "WHY I WON'T BE ABLE TO JOIN YOU ALL IN DELHI...!
Despite all efforts of the government to hinder & damage our work we continue to work for national security... making preparations as another winter comes.
This includes making artificial glaciers for water security & experiments for GLOF or glacial lake flood security... to difuse the 200+ ticking water bombs in high Himalayas.
Adapting Faiz Sahab's words I would say...
Aur Bhi Gham Hain Zamaane Main Siyaast Ke Siva...
Rahaten aur bhi hain wasl ki raahat ke siva.

Hence I send my bestest wishes to all & urge the leaders of different groups to stay united & show statesmanship, meanwhile I urge all the genZ friends to once again stay absolutely peaceful at all costs. This was the gift of Baapu that I tried to bring to Jantar Mantar in June, I hope we won't let Baapu down.
#JantarMantar #protest #CJP #CEC #sonamwangchuk".

posts.meta_description:
48K likes, 66 comments - zoramthangaofficial on September 29, 2026: "I had the privilege of a warm and fruitful interaction when Pu Sonam Wangchuk, the renowned Engineer, Educator and Activist, celebrated for leading various movements, called on me at Mizoram House, New Delhi. I am truly honoured that such a distinguished and highly admired personality among the youth of India took the time to have a long conversation with me.

In our conversation, we spoke about national politics as well as regional politics, the affairs of the present world and the pressing concerns of our youth today. Pu Wangchuk expressed his keen desire to study the Memorandum of Settlement between Mizoram and India, and shared his wish that he and his colleagues from Ladakh would like to meet again, either in Mizoram or as may be mutually convenient. For my part, I told him that this Peace Accord, being the most enduring, stable and successful one, has been studied from time to time by individuals and other regions as a subject worthy of learning, and that we, the people of Mizoram who are blessed with one of the most lasting and exemplary accords of its kind, would wish that others too may have such a peace.

We intend to have another meaningful interaction in the near future. During our meeting, I had the pleasure of serving Pu Sonam Wangchuk with Mizo chhangban, our traditional sticky rice cake prepared at the @mizoram_house_kitchen and our special Mizo tea. Although it was his first time tasting it, he was kind enough to say that he found it delicious. I also presented him with a scanned copy of the original Memorandum of Settlement and my book titled From Guerrilla Fighter to Chief Minister.".

28K likes, 254 comments - wangchuksworld on September 27, 2026: "A HEART TO HEART CHAT WITH THE NATION...
Not just a Press Release. 
One year after my first morning in Jodhpur Central Jail where I was kept in total isolation for six months under the draconian NSA, I have more questions than I had before. 
Unfortunately there was a media blackout on Ladakh 3 days ago when I voiced these questions from Leh as Ladakh observed Martyrs Day in memory for those who lost their lives last year on the same day. Here are some of those questions I asked from Delhi today. 
I'm sure the NATION WANTS TO KNOW TOO...
#Ladakh #JusticeForLadakh #AmitShahMustResign #NeetPaperLeak".

361K likes, 3,820 comments - wangchuksworld on September 24, 2026: "AMIT SHAH MUST RESIGN...
Today Ladakh commemorated the first anniversary of indiscriminate firing with AK 47 on unarmed youth that lead to the killing of 4+1, injury to 80+ & FIRs against 80+.
Even after one year, the report of the Judicial Inquiry commission is suppressed & a paltry compensation of 15 lakh rupees for the dead & 3 lakhs for the severely injured has been announced. In this video I expose the root cause of the firing in Leh & also support Shri @RahulGandhi in his call #AmitShahMustResign for brutal firing with pallet guns at #JantarMantar.
Youth of Ladakh have always stood for the nation during all wars, it's time the nation stands for them.
Jai Hind".

59K likes, 550 comments - wangchuksworld on September 22, 2026: "IN THE VALLEY OF NUBRA GUARDS
Civilian volunteers who fought for the nation & won huge areas in 1971 war with Pakistan.
People of Ladakh have always stood for the nation & now it’s time the nation stands with Ladakh.
On 23rd there’ll be a historic peaceful Padyatra March towards Leh. On 24th September there’ll be all faith prayers organised by the LBA in memory of 4+1 people who died in indiscriminate firing last year.
Look forward to marching with you and many journalists, YouTubers who we hope will carry our message to the nation.".
